responsibility: Infers generic-parameter variance for the local crate by running a crate-wide pipeline that assigns inference variables and symbolic variance terms to variance-relevant items (including hardcoded special cases), collects symbolic constraints from item definitions and their contained types, regions, consts, signatures, mutability, and substitutions, solves those constraints to a fixed point using the module’s variance-lattice combination operations plus required postprocessing rules, exposes the resulting per-item variances through queries, and provides a testing hook that reports computed variances for annotated items.
